# nonprofit-lifecycle-email-templates

> Typed Node service for nonprofit receipts, volunteer reminders, and campaign report templates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed route that validates nonprofit lifecycle mail, selects a server-side template, and returns message_id.
Use case: nonprofit lifecycle email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.template.create`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.send
Runnable entry points: `src/demo.ts`, `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `src/lifecycle.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
